message.reasoning_content: Question Arabic: "..........هو قلب شكل حول مستقيم" Means "______ is the reflection of a shape about a line". Options: A. الشبكة (grid), B. التماثل (symmetry), C. الانعكاس (reflection). Correct: الانعكاس.
